probes.name: unchanged
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim target As Workbook, parts As Object, part As Object
Dim moduleName As String, documentName As String, text As String, number As Long
Application.EnableEvents = False
Application.DisplayAlerts = False
Set target = Workbooks.Add
Set parts = target.VBProject.VBComponents
Set part = parts.Add(1)
part.Name = "Helpers"
part.CodeModule.AddFromString "Private Stored As Long" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub Mark(ByVal number As Long)" & vbCrLf & "Stored = number" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Function Read() As Long" & vbCrLf & "Read = Stored" & vbCrLf & "End Function"
parts.Item("Sheet1").CodeModule.AddFromString "Public Stored As Long" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub Mark(ByVal number As Long)" & vbCrLf & "Stored = number" & vbCrLf & "End Sub" & vbCrLf & "Public Sub ExportValue()" & vbCrLf & "Range(""A1"").Value = Stored" & vbCrLf & "End Sub"
moduleName = "Helpers"
documentName = "Sheet1"
Application.Run "'" & target.Name & "'!Helpers.Mark", 42
Application.Run "'" & target.Name & "'!Sheet1.Mark", 33

Probe = CStr(Application.Run("'" & target.Name & "'!" & moduleName & ".Read"))
Application.Run "'" & target.Name & "'!" & documentName & ".ExportValue"
Probe = Probe & ":" & CStr(target.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value)
target.Close False
End Function
